svg.title: Prior art panel: what the cluster contributed versus what it rediscovered, with the citation audit tally of 37 items

g.text: NEW, as far as the sweeps could tell
the provability reading itself: no provability predicate
anywhere in the published geometry
no rotation-covariant order on the equator
a Boolean ring has no odd part, for any grading group
the broadcasting refutation of the ball applied to proofs
(no prior art found; the finding its essay most wants shot down)
ALREADY PUBLISHED
the geometry: Sperling and Walmsley, Phys. Rev. A 97,
062327 (2018), section IV.3 "True, false, and undecidable"
the architecture: proof-carrying code (Necula and Lee 1998),
Milawa's eleven-level tower, partial reflection schemas
(Harrison, SRI CRC-053, 1995), LCF-style kernels
the simplex-iff-compatible equivalence, and the
three-status fragment, which is Kleene K3 relabelled
The citation audit, 37 items checked
28 CONFIRMED
5 WRONG
4 UNRESOLVED
All 11 recommended corrections were applied. The two audited Faizal papers came out clean, both quoted lines verbatim on the stated pages.
